name: League of Volunteers Teen Volunteers (Summer Recreation)
city: Newark, CA (serves Fremont, Newark and Union City)
what_you_do: Help lead activities and assist staff at the League's summer recreation program for kids. The League says teen volunteers gain leadership experience.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 13 to 17. The page does not state a residency rule for volunteers.
duration: The 2026 summer recreation program ran July 6 to July 30, 2026, Monday to Thursday, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m., at Mayhews Landing Park in Newark.
deadline_text: The homepage showed a 2026 summer teen volunteer call. No 2027 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Register to Volunteer link for the teen volunteer call on the League site, or email lov@lov.org. Phone (510) 793-5683.
notes: The teen call on the homepage is for summer 2026. Confirm with the League whether it recruits again for 2027. Serves the Tri-Cities (Fremont, Newark and Union City).
